subject: Integration kickoff: HealthSync SDK + streaming & tool-calls (MAP draft)
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@healthsync.io>; Chris Tan <chris.tan@healthsync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-23T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Integration kickoff: HealthSync SDK + streaming & tool-calls (MAP draft)

Hi Alex / Chris —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed set of next steps so we can lock the MAP milestones for the integration build:

High-level asks from HealthSync on the call:
- SDK embed + example app (mobile + server)
- Real-time streaming for event ingestion (low single-digit latencies)
- Tool-calling for structured EMR lookups (we need example tool contracts)
- Structured JSON outputs for downstream processing

Draft MAP milestones (attached as HealthSync_MAP_v0.1.xlsx):
1) Discovery & API spec sign-off — target: 2026-06-03 — owner: HealthSync (Alex) + Redwood AM
2) SDK PoC (server SDK + sample integration) — target: 2026-06-17 — owner: Redwood (Ben)
3) Streaming integration (end-to-end event flow) — target: 2026-06-30 — owner: Redwood (Marissa)
4) Tool-call contracts + test harness — target: 2026-07-07 — owner: HealthSync devs + Redwood eng
5) Pilot cutover & validation — target: 2026-07-21 — owner: Shared

Dependencies called out on the call:
- HealthSync to provide sample event schema and a staging API key by 2026-05-28
- Approval of data retention and logging model (SOC2/PII considerations)
- Mapping of tool-call outputs to HealthSync EMR fields

Please confirm owners/dates or flag any constraints. I attached the MAP draft and a short SOW draft for planning. Once you confirm, I’ll update the MAP and create a HubSpot deal task list (linked in the header).

Next steps / asks (concrete):
- Alex: confirm you can provide sample event schema and a staging API key by 5/28
- HealthSync: confirm legal review timeline for SOW (attached)
- Ben / Marissa: confirm feasibility for streaming latency targets and estimate dev days for PoC

Thanks —
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0186

Attachments (stubs): HealthSync_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_draft_HealthSync.pdf (pdf)
From: Alex Mercer <alex@healthsync.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Tan <chris.tan@healthsync.io>
Date: 2026-05-23T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration kickoff: HealthSync SDK + streaming & tool-calls (MAP draft)

Avery — thanks for the concise breakdown. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- We can provide a sample event schema and a staging API key by 2026-05-28 (will send to marissa@redwood.ai once ready).
- Legal will need about two weeks to review the SOW (so earliest sign-off ~ 2026-06-07).
- Tool-calls are critical for our EMR lookup flow; I’ll loop in our senior engineer, Chris, to work the mapping and define the initial contract.

Small ask: for the streaming milestone can you include a short perf target doc (p95 latency, throughput expectations) so our infra team can plan?

We’re excited to move forward — would like to keep the PoC target if the dev estimate is reasonable.

— Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Integrations, HealthSync
alex@healthsync.io

On 2026-05-23 10:12, Avery Johnson wrote:
> Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed set of next steps...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@healthsync.io>; Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-24T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration kickoff: HealthSync SDK + streaming & tool-calls (MAP draft)

Alex / Avery —

Appreciate the confirmations. Technical notes and owner assignments from the Redwood eng side: 

- SDK PoC (owner: Ben Carter) — Ben will produce a server SDK sample and a minimal mobile example. Expect ~6 dev days for the PoC (design + tests).
- Streaming (owner: Marissa Cole) — We’ll deliver an event ingestion plan and perf targets doc by 2026-05-28. Targets I propose: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 350ms for single-event processing in a typical staging network; throughput target for PoC: 200 req/sec sustained. I’ll put these numbers in the perf doc and we can iterate.
- Tool-calling (owner: Ben + HealthSync devs) — We need an initial JSON contract for the call and a test harness; Ben will sketch the test harness and provide a template contract.

Dependencies and blocking items (technical):
- Staging API key + event schema from HealthSync (Alex)
- Confirmed retention and redaction requirements for logging (security/compliance)
- A small sandbox dataset (anonymized) to validate structured outputs mapping

I’ll attach the perf doc and a short integration checklist to the HubSpot deal once Avery confirms owners/dates.

Marissa Cole
Senior Engineer, Integrations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Alex / team —

Confirming I’ll own the SDK PoC and the tool-call harness. Quick notes: 
- PoC plan (deliverables): server SDK + sample integration, mobile snippet, CI smoke tests, README + example dataset.
- Dev estimate: 6 dev days for PoC + 3 days to wire the tool-call harness and contract templates. We can hit the 2026-06-17 PoC target if we get the staging key and schema by 5/28.
- Repo & artifacts (stub): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-integration-healthsync — I’ll open the PoC branch today and add an initial README.

I’ve attached a short SOW draft to this thread as well (SOW_draft_HealthSync.pdf).

Ben Carter
SDK Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
